notes: Json.Decode.field on an array accepts "length" and the canonical index names that are in range, as Elm (JavaScript: the test of field in value). Expected lines recorded from Elm 0.19.3 + node.
expected_lines:
length-wrong-type: Err "Problem with the value at json.length:

    2

Expecting a STRING"

index-too-large: Err "Problem with the given value:

[
        10,
        20,
        30
    ]

Expecting an OBJECT with a field named `3`"

index-wrong-type: Err "Problem with the value at json['1']:

    20

Expecting a STRING"

on-null: Err "Problem with the given value:

null

Expecting an OBJECT with a field named `length`"
